The '''''Heart's Dagger''''' was an [[X4 Gunship/Legends|X4 Gunship]] that was used by the [[Velocity Mercenaries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was destroyed by [[Black Epsilon]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG:TiEC" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Heart's Dagger'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TiEC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Heart's Dagger'' was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:TiEC" />
